items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

items.title: Outlook: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
items.description: If you don’t want to check spelling manually for every message—or you’re worried you might forget!—you can set Outlook to check spelling for you every time before sending emails.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Monitor tab
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Agent Evaluations
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly associated with their evaluations, including a breakdown of usage for eval generation, test runs and model grading/judgement. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage transparent throughout the development lifecycle.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History
items.description: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run. Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.
The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

items.title: PowerPoint:  Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Web)
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for PowerPoint Agent (Windows Desktop)
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.description: Two presenters can share a screen or window at the same time in a Teams meeting. Participants can see both shared content streams simultaneously, making it easier to compare and discuss content from different presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
items.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Changes to local IP address detection for proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts
items.description: Microsoft Edge is changing how it selects the local network address reported to proxy auto-config (PAC) scripts and is adding administrator control over it. The default IPv4 and IPv6 probe destinations now match Chromium’s defaults. Administrators can override these defaults using the PacMyIpAddressIPv4ProbeAddress and PacMyIpAddressIPv6ProbeAddress policies when required by their network routing.

items.title: OneDrive: Exclude specific folders from syncing
items.description: OneDrive for Windows and Mac will let users exclude specific folders from syncing, so folders that do not belong in the cloud, such as developer tooling folders like PowerShell modules, Visual Studio configuration, and node modules, stay local on the device instead of uploading to OneDrive. Administrators can define folder exclusion rules for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
items.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
items.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics: Copilot usage snapshot PBI at day level with fresh data
items.description: A day level Copilot adoption Power BI report reflecting the most recent copilot activity & freshest insights.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Expand protection to Copilot + PC devices for Recall snapshots through custom policies
items.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint data loss prevention is expanding coverage to Copilot + PCs initially to support Recall snapshots and determining whether policies exist to prevent capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and Sensitive information types (SITs). Purview admins will author Endpoint DLP custom policies to integrate with Windows Copilot + PC Recall setup by Intune admins for Copilot + PC devices exclusively.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description:
Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.
This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Express voice enrollment makes registering your voice in Teams fast and easy. Your profile enables features like voice isolation, speaker recognition, identification in a meeting room and transcripts, and enhanced meeting recaps and insights from Microsoft 365 Copilot. If you don’t yet have a voice profile, just go to the recognition tab in Teams settings and opt-in to enroll your voice simply by speaking during a meeting.  Admins can enable or disable this feature.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
items.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows.  Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 Copilot – Chat & Search Browser Extension for Chrome
items.description: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience. The Microsoft 365 Copilot browser extension for Chrome brings Copilot Chat and Search directly into the browser, enabling users to ask questions, summarize webpages, and search enterprise content without switching tabs. This improves productivity, reduces context switching, and provides secure, compliant in-browser AI assistance for Microsoft 365 users.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Semantic Goodbye word for voice in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Now users can close a voice session on Windows by simply saying bye or goodbye when they want to close voice session. This, paired with "Hey Copilot" wake word, provides them with complete hands-free experience for voice in Microsoft 365 Copilot on Windows devices.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility]​​[Search UX] Rich entity representation for connectors in Search results
items.description: Rich entity representation for connectors in Search results.

items.title: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
items.description: AI citations analytics will help you track the usage of SP documents, news and pages through copilot and AI agents. You will be able to see how often a page or a file is referenced in a copilot response. You can also get insights into SharePoint site content getting referenced in copilot responses aggregated at the site level.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Outlook: New Cloud Policy controls
items.description: We’re introducing Cloud Policy service support for Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows. Admins can set default values for supported Outlook settings and choose whether users can change them, providing consistent cloud-based control across their organization

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
items.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
items.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classi

items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
items.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done i

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Ability to protect files stored in the excluded folders in Windows
items.description: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData. This helps improve coverage by detecting and protecting sensitive data in these locations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Allow customer to scope JIT Audit to specific user or user group
items.description: Enable customers to include or exclude users/user groups from Just‑In‑Time (JIT) Audit, ensuring audits are generated only for the selected users or groups.

items.title: Access: Zooming for Continuous Forms and Multiple-Items Forms
items.description: Access extends zoom capabilities to continuous forms and pop-up forms, building on zoom support already available in tables and queries. Adjust magnification from 10 percent to 500 percent using the slider in the lower-right corner or controls on the ribbon. Keyboard shortcuts are also available, making it easy to quickly change your view and focus on the details that matter most.

items.title: Access: Rounded corners on Access form controls
items.description: We’re making it easier to give your Access apps a polished, up-to-date feel. With the new CornerRadius property, you can add rounded corners to form controls—bringing a softer, more modern look to your designs.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Settings in classic Outlook for Windows
items.description: You will now be able to access different Copilot settings directly in classic Outlook for Windows.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Introducing Exchange Online Cross-tenant Message Recall
items.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-M will able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Access: Enable zoom magnification to Microsoft Access for Forms, Tables, Queries
items.description: Access will add magnification slider (10% to 500%) in lower right of the application, similar to the feature in Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. It will also be keyboard accessible and available on the ribbon in Access forms, tables, and queries.
